question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

CLEAR
solution:
The correct answer is: **Dim**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The word **"clear"** means easy to understand, bright, or free from confusion or doubt. (स्पष्ट / साफ)

 
 
• **Example: **The teacher gave a clear explanation of the topic.
 
 
 
• **"Dim"** means not bright or not clear; lacking clarity or sharpness. (धुंधला / अस्पष्ट)
 
 
• **Example: **The light in the room was too dim to read properly.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'clear'** is **'dim'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Dim**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings:

 
• **Doubt** (संदेह): A feeling of uncertainty or lack of confidence.
 
• **Open** (खुला): Not closed or allowing access; also can mean honest or frank.
 
• **Known** (ज्ञात): Recognized or familiar to people.
